Persons, W. S.; Currie, P. J. (2011). Farke, Andrew Allen. ed. "Dinosaur Speed Demon: The caudal musculature of Carnotaurus sastrei and implications for the evolution of South American abelisaurids". PLoS ONE 6 (10): e25763. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0025763. PMC 3197156. PMID 22043292
payload.description_html:
Lateral and dorsal views of the robustly modeled tail of Carnotaurus sastrei (MACN-CH 894).

(A) Digital reconstruction of the caudal and pelvic skeleton with M. caudofemoralis longus (red). (B) Complete digital reconstruction, with epaxial musculature (orange) and M. ilio-ischiocaudalis (pink) added.
